verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no documented system-to-system channel for filing or transacting: no system accounts, transmitter program, batch-filing provider program, or published enrollment path. The only machine-adjacent hint is a passing reference to 'requestors of Bulk data', which is a read-only data feed with no documented enrollment. User Access is a human web-account control for online filings, and probes found no OpenAPI or API documentation, with the bizfile portal sitting behind bot management.
